name: Portable Battery Program
description: Free portable battery for Medical Baseline or Self-Identified Vulnerable customers who rely on medical devices and experienced a PSPS outage or 3+ EPSS outages since 2024
fullDescription: PG&E provides free portable backup batteries to customers who depend on electricity for medical equipment and have experienced power shutoffs, ensuring they can maintain critical care during outages.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free portable backup battery sized to your equipment
- For Medical Baseline customers
- For Self-Identified Vulnerable customers
- Powers medical devices and assistive technology during outages
- For those who experienced a PSPS outage or 3+ EPSS outages since 2024
- Referral to the Disability Disaster Access & Resources Program if your needs exceed a portable battery
howToGetIt:
1. Must be enrolled in Medical Baseline program
2. Or registered as Self-Identified Vulnerable customer
3. Must rely on a medical device, assistive technology, or durable medical equipment
4. Must have experienced a PSPS outage or 3+ EPSS outages since 2024
5. No application needed; PG&E's program partners contact eligible customers directly for an assessment
6. Battery delivered at no cost
keywords: portable battery, free, PG&E, Medical Baseline, medical equipment, CPAP, oxygen, PSPS, outage, disability
